source.title: Role of the mesolimbic dopamine system in relief learning

confidence_rationale: Causal, multi-method (6-OHDA lesion, DREADD silencing, intra-accumbens raclopride) rodent evidence that a specific mesolimbic projection is necessary for relief learning. Supports SD-050's shared-machinery premise at the transmitter level -- the same VTA-to-accumbens dopaminergic substrate that carries appetitive reward is required for relief -- and thereby corroborates the Navratilova 2012 grounding already in the claim with a stronger causal design. Simultaneously weakens the strong reuse reading: the required projection is ANATOMICALLY SPECIFIC (posterior medial VTA to accumbens shell) and the manipulations spared fear learning and safety learning, so relief has a dedicated route rather than being a generic call into the reward pathway. 0.71 reflects convergent causal methods against a mapping that is about substrate identity rather than detector form.
failure_signatures: Relief learning was blocked while fear learning and safety learning were unaffected by the same manipulations -- a specificity SD-050 does not implement, since its comparator writes through the generic MECH-094 VALENCE_LIKING path shared with goal-achievement.

The necessary projection is a narrow anatomical subdivision (pmVTA to AcbSh), not the mesolimbic system as a whole; a REE implementation that treats 'dopaminergic reward machinery' as one undifferentiated resource cannot express the distinction this result depends on.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The dopaminergic projection from posterior medial VTA to nucleus accumbens shell is activated by aversive electric stimuli and is critical for relief learning: 6-OHDA lesions of pmVTA blocked relief learning while sparing fear and safety learning, and both DREADD silencing of the pmVTA-AcbSh projection and intra-AcbSh raclopride inhibited relief learning.
mapping.ree_translation: Supports SD-050's premise that the end of a suffering period is registered by the same dopaminergic valence machinery that registers appetitive outcomes -- the biological warrant for routing relief-completion into MECH-094's VALENCE_LIKING write rather than inventing a separate valence channel. Qualifies it by showing that the route is a dedicated sub-projection dissociable from neighbouring learning types, which argues REE should be able to ablate relief-completion independently of goal-achievement tagging even while both write to the same field.
mapping.mapping_caveat: This is evidence about the SUBSTRATE that carries a relief signal, not about how the relief EVENT is detected -- it says nothing about descent detection, window length, or threshold, which are SD-050's actual content. The aversive event is again an experimenter-delivered electric stimulus with a clean offset, so the range-degeneracy problem that currently makes SD-050's falsifier uninterpretable is not addressed. Rodent-to-REE transfer of an anatomical specificity finding is weak: REE has no pmVTA/AcbSh distinction to preserve.
mapping.source_context: Sprague Dawley rats, relief-learning conditioning procedure; anatomical tracing, c-Fos immunohistochemistry, 6-OHDA lesions, chemogenetic (DREADD) silencing, and local D2/3 antagonism.

confidence_components.notes: Three converging causal manipulations plus anatomical and immunohistochemical localisation put source quality high. Mapping fidelity is capped because the result concerns substrate identity while SD-050's content is detector form; transfer risk is moderate-to-high because the finding's force lies in an anatomical distinction REE does not represent.
